channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Two-Time Grand Slam Finalist and World No. 3 Amanda Anisimova Enters Charleston Tennis Tournament
item.description: Coming off the biggest season of her career, Amanda Anisimova has committed to play the 2026 Credit One Charleston Open, North America’s largest women’s-only professional tennis event.

item.title: Vibes for Vets II Returns with All-Day Concert on Daniel Island
item.description: Lowcountry Veterans Home will host Vibes for Vets II, a free, all-day live music event Saturday, Feb. 7, 2026, from 12:30 to 9 p.m. at New Realm Brewing on Daniel Island.

item.title: Halls Chophouse Nexton Sponsoring Local Dog Adoptions
item.description: Halls Chophouse Nexton announced a new community partnership supporting animal welfare. In partnership with Charleston Animal Society’s Berkeley Animal Campus, Dogtopia of Summerville will partner in facilitating adoption opportunities

item.title: Ladybird Books to Host Event with Keith Smalls on Jan. 21
item.description: Ladybird Books will kick off its 2026 event season with an author event on Wednesday, Jan. 21, from 6:30 to 7:30 p.m. (doors open at 6 p.m.), featuring local author, speaker and violence prevention advocate Keith Smalls.

item.title: 39 Rue de Jean Announces the Return of Weekday Lunch
item.description: 39 Rue de Jean announced the return of weekday lunch service beginning Monday, Jan. 12, marking the start of a yearlong celebration in honor of the restaurant’s 25th anniversary.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Alex Pelbath
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Stingrays Win Fourth Straight with 2-1 Victory Over Greenville
item.description: In their eighth meeting this season, the South Carolina Stingrays rallied from a goal down to beat the Greenville Swamp Rabbits, 2-1, on Saturday evening at the Bon Secours Wellness Arena.

item.title: Charleston Climate Coalition to Rally Against Proposed Edisto River Gas Plant
item.description: The Charleston Climate Coalition will hold a press conference and rally Jan. 13 to oppose Dominion Energy’s plans to build a large natural gas plant on the Edisto River and a new pipeline through the ACE Basin to supply it.

item.title: Warming Centers Opening Sunday and Monday Due to Cold Weather
item.description: Due to forecasted cold weather, the City of Charleston and community partners will open Warming Centers on Sunday, January 11, and Monday, January 12, 2026, to provide safe, warm accommodations for individuals and families in need.

item.title: Local Musician Casey Wells to Release New Single
item.description: Local Indie-psych artist Casey Wells’ upcoming single "Beating Heart" is a mesmerizing blend of psychedelic pop and electronica that showcases his signature atmospheric sound. The single will be available on all streaming platforms Jan. 15.
